# README assets

`banner-light.png` and `banner-dark.png` are the README banner for light and dark GitHub themes, rendered at 3200 × 1040 from [`source/banner.html`](source/banner.html). GitHub Pages does not serve the `.github/` folder, so none of this is part of the redirect site. This repository is public: keep images free of personal or private data.

## Visual identity

This site redirects to www.mihirkavishwar.com, so its README echoes the portfolio's identity:

- **Type:** Inter 590 with −0.07em tracking and a Georgia italic cobalt accent (as on the portfolio's home page), plus JetBrains Mono for the URLs.
- **Colors:** canvas `#f5f4ef`, ink `#15171a`, muted `#5b6067`, line `#d8d7d1`, cobalt `#2457e6`; dark theme on `#141a24` with cobalt `#7c9cff`. Badges use ink, cobalt and muted.
- **Motif:** an old address bar (struck through) forwarding to the matching mihirkavishwar.com path, and a note that project sites stay untouched. The cobalt M is drawn in CSS, so no image is copied here.

Re-render after editing the source; see [`source/README.md`](source/README.md).
